scams.name: Family emergency / grandparent scam
scams.summary: Someone pretending to be a grandchild or relative says they are in jail or hurt and need money right away, and begs you not to tell anyone.

scams.name: Government impersonation (IRS / Social Security)
scams.basis: General knowledge; FTC reports government imposter losses of $789M in 2024
scams.summary: A message claims to be from the IRS, Social Security or another agency and threatens arrest, suspension or fines unless you pay or share your SSN.

scams.name: Tech support / virus popup
scams.summary: A popup, email or text says your computer has a virus and tells you to call a fake support number, then asks for remote access or payment.

vi: máy tính của bạn bị khóa

scams.name: Lottery / inheritance / sweepstakes
scams.summary: You are told you won a prize or are owed an inheritance, but must first pay a fee or share personal details to claim it.

scams.name: Fake package delivery / postal alert
scams.basis: FTC Top Text Scams 2024 (#1 most reported)
scams.summary: A text posing as USPS or a courier says a package could not be delivered and sends you to a fake site for a small redelivery fee, which steals your card or SSN.

es: no se pudo entregar su paquete

scams.name: Fake traffic stop / unpaid ticket
scams.summary: A message claiming to be from the DMV, court or police says you owe an unpaid traffic ticket and threatens license suspension unless you pay now through a link.

scams.name: Bogus toll notice
scams.summary: A text impersonating SunPass, E-ZPass or a toll agency says you owe a small unpaid toll and links to a fake payment page.

scams.name: Phony job / task scam
scams.basis: FTC Top Text Scams 2024; FTC 2024: business and job opportunity losses $750.6M
scams.summary: An unsolicited offer of easy work-from-home pay for tasks like rating apps, then you are pressured to send money before you can withdraw your earnings.

scams.name: Fake fraud alert (bank / Amazon)
scams.summary: A message posing as your bank or Amazon reports a suspicious charge and pressures you to reply or call a number to 'secure your funds'.

vi: trả lời CÓ để xác nhận

scams.name: Wrong-number / romance-investment scam
scams.summary: A stranger 'accidentally' texts you, starts a friendly or romantic conversation, then steers you to a fake investment platform.

scams.name: Account verification phishing
scams.basis: FBI spoofing & phishing category (page could not be read; unverified)
scams.summary: A message says there was unusual activity or your account is locked and asks you to click a link and log in, which hands your password to the scammer.

scams.name: Spoofed invoice / payment request
scams.basis: FBI spoofing & phishing category (page could not be read; unverified)
scams.summary: A fake invoice or 'final notice' from a vendor or company asks you to pay, often to a new bank account, by wire transfer.

scams.name: Impersonating someone you know (spear phishing)
scams.basis: FBI spoofing & phishing category (page could not be read; unverified)
scams.summary: A message that looks like it is from your boss, pastor or friend asks for a quick favor, usually to buy gift cards and send the codes.

scams.name: Medicare / health insurance scam
scams.summary: Someone claims you need a new Medicare card or qualify for free medical equipment and asks for your Medicare or Social Security number.

vi: thiết bị y tế miễn phí

scams.name: Utility shutoff threat
scams.summary: A message claiming to be your power or water company says service will be cut off within hours unless you pay immediately, often by prepaid card.

tl: lampas na sa due ang bill
magbayad sa loob ng isang oras

scams.name: Fake subscription renewal / auto-charge
scams.summary: A message says your antivirus or service subscription was just renewed for a large amount and tells you to call a number to cancel and get a refund.

vi: gói đăng ký đã bị tính phí

scams.name: Fake charity / disaster donation
scams.summary: After a disaster or in the holidays, a fake charity pressures you to donate right away, often by gift card, wire or crypto.

vi: quyên góp bằng thẻ quà tặng

scams.name: Student loan forgiveness / debt relief
scams.summary: An offer to erase your loans or debt for an upfront fee, claiming limited-time government programs.

scams.name: Crypto / investment opportunity
scams.basis: FTC 2024: investment scams were the top loss category at $5.7B
scams.summary: Promises of guaranteed or doubled returns on a trading or crypto platform, which shows fake profits but blocks withdrawals unless you pay more.

scams.name: Payment app 'sent by mistake' scam
scams.summary: Someone says they sent you money by mistake on Zelle, Venmo or Cash App and asks you to send it back, but their payment is fake or reversed.

tl: nagpadala ako ng pera nang mali
vi: tôi chuyển nhầm tiền cho bạn
